facts.business: Bharat Bijlee Limited designs, manufactures, and markets power transformers, EPC projects for electrical substations, electric motors, magnet technology machines, and drives and automation systems across Power Systems and Industrial Systems segments.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Transformer business expansion to be completed before end of this year
Focus on strengthening market share in 400kV transformer segment
Target larger sized projects and 400kV projects in Projects business
Increase market share in metals, printing and packaging verticals for Drives and Automation
Expect increase in volume in domestic gearless machines market for Magnet Technology Machines

key_risks: Currency fluctuations (Euro appreciation ~17% YoY impacting Drives margins)
Supply chain disruptions and specific magnet grade availability
Fierce price competition in projects and motor segments
Difficulty passing on inflated raw material prices to customers
Liquidated damages and price variation claims on extended delivery schedules
